transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I'm having trouble at work. I'm a nurse, and lately, I just keep losing my train of thought on the floor. It's like... if an IV pump beeps, or I hear someone asking another nurse a question, or a call light goes off, I just completely forget what patient flow issue I was working on. It happens constantly.
Are you experiencing these memory lapses or difficulties with concentration in situations outside of work as well?

Um... yeah. It's not just at the hospital. 

I guess I just forget things that should be... routine. Like paying a bill at home, or... calling a family member back. I'll mean to do it, and I just don't. Sometimes I even miss appointments after I've set a reminder on my phone. Or, you know, forgetting to follow up on a missing order... it just slips my mind.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
No... not really. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling like that.
Have you been feeling anxious or depressed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I'm depressed or... anxious. Just... frustrated with myself, I guess. But no.
Are you having difficulty completing tasks at home due to these memory lapses?
Um... I suppose. Sometimes things just don't get finished. But... I don't really know.
Do you find it hard to focus on a single task for an extended period of time?
I mean... I'm not really sure. I guess it just depends on what it is. I haven't really kept track of how long I focus on things.
Do you find yourself easily distracted?

Um... yeah. I guess that's... that's kind of the main reason I came in. At work—on the floor—I just... I lose my train of thought constantly. Like, if an IV pump beeps, or... a call light goes off, or even if someone just asks another nurse a question... suddenly I've just completely forgotten what patient flow issue I was working on. So... yeah.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of sadness or irritability?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I haven't really noticed feeling sad or anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you feel overwhelmed by your forgetfulness and difficulty concentrating?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It's just... it's been a problem. 

At work, the concerns have gotten serious enough that... well, they actually put me on formal supervision. The other nurses are having to double-check parts of my follow-through when I'm charge nurse. It's... yeah. I just feel like I'm becoming a liability instead of a leader.
Do you often feel mentally tired?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really thought about it like that. I'm just... trying to get through my shifts.
Do you feel like your mind is exhausted after a long day?
Um... I don't really know. I mean, I'm just tired in general. Working a full shift on the floor is... it's just tiring. I haven't really separated it out like that. I just go home and try to sleep.
Do you feel like you're unable to think clearly after a long day at work?
Um... I'm not really sure. Like I said, I'm just worn out by the time my shift is over. I haven't really noticed if my thinking is worse right then... I just try to get home and rest.
Do you feel like you're disconnected from your emotions or the people around you?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I interact with my patients and the other nurses all day. I haven't really noticed feeling like that.
Do you ever feel like you're observing yourself from outside your body?
No... I've never experienced anything like that. I just feel like myself, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or spaced out?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I get tired, but... I don't think I'm ever in a daze. I just... keep doing my job.
Are you having trouble meeting your responsibilities at home because of your memory lapses and difficulty concentrating?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I forget things that should be routine. Like paying a bill at home, or... calling a family member back. Missing an appointment. It happens with work stuff too, like following up on a missing order. I mean to do it all, I really do. Sometimes I even set a reminder and I still... yeah. I just forget.
Have you noticed any significant impact on your personal relationships due to your memory lapses and difficulty concentrating?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, like I said, I forget to call people back sometimes, but... I wouldn't say it's had a huge impact. Things are... fine, mostly.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain tasks or situations because of your difficulty concentrating?

Um... yeah. I guess I do. At work... if there's something that needs a lot of focus, like... auditing the charts across different shifts... I just... I push it off. I'll go find something to do at the bedside instead. Sitting down to do the chart review just feels... I don't know, like trying to climb a wall. So I just avoid it.
Do you feel like you're emotionally disconnected from things that normally would upset or excite you?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I still feel things normally, I guess. It's just the focusing part that's hard.
Do you ever feel like you're disconnected from what's happening around you?

Um... no. I don't... I don't really feel disconnected like that. I'm there, I know what's going on around me. I just... I just lose my train of thought sometimes. But I'm not... checked out of reality or anything.
